text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services staff have reviewed the need for traffic calming on Robert Street, between Willcocks Street and Harbord Street, to address residents' concerns regarding the speed of vehicles. Our assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the traffic calming policy has not been satisfied. Therefore, traffic calming should not be installed on Robert Street, between Willcocks Street and Harbord Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council directed: 1. The City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway on Robert Street, between Willcocks Street and Harbord Street, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on the copy of Drawing No. 421G-2993, dated May 2018, attached to the report (April 23, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
